# 🚨 Launch Alert: Codebase Reports


[@hbrooks · Hunter Brooks](https://github.com/hbrooks)


Codebase Reports are now available.


Simply select a repository and a delivery window to get a daily, weekly, or monthly digest of what's changed in your codebase. Reports can be delivered via Slack and email.


Set one up in the[dashboard](https://app.ellipsis.dev/) , or read more in the[reports docs](https://www.ellipsis.dev/docs) .
